<subject>Re: Lumière Santé, Lyon Database</subject>
<body>
Bernard,

We've completed a review this morning to try to fill in missing pieces of information on hourly patient flow, clinic resource allocation history, and inter-departmental transfers for Lyon and have not come up with anything yet. Would you know of any of the above information which would assist us in our efforts? Thanks, Eugène Leconte
</body>
<quoted>
----- Original Message -----
From: Adrien
To: Bernard Schmitt
Cc: Édouard Pruvost ; Aimé Ruiz ; Honoré Allard
Sent: Wednesday, January 8, 2025 6:20 PM
Subject: Lumière Santé, Lyon Database

Bernard,

Below, I have summarized Clinical Operations' work on the Lyon database to date. The "Inter_Regional Patient Flow" file shows the topology and links between departments in our model and "Expand_France_Data_011000.xls" details the existing patient information that we have compiled to date. Total resources closely match reported resources as shown in "Patient_L&R_0110.xls". Reported Lyon total in 1997 is 86,000 patient-days and that in the Clinical Operations database is 84,000 patient-days through 1997.


Marseille

We are currently working on the development of hourly patient flow shaping, seasonal bed allocation, and the gathering of transfer information. Bernard, we will try to contact you tomorrow (Thursday -- Australia or Wednesday -- Paris) to answer any questions that you may have on this information. Sincerely, Eugène Leconte
</quoted>
